product.name: vformjs
product.positioning: Typed CRUD form lifecycle for Vue 2.7 and Vue 3 while the existing UI Form keeps rendering and field validation ownership.
boundaries: Keep inputs, layout, accessibility, focus, scroll, and visual validation in the host UI library.
Own create/edit/detail modes, reset baselines, dirty state, changed paths, submit state, linkage, dynamic arrays, and API errors.
Do not become a second field-level form engine beside vee-validate, Vuelidate, or similar libraries.
Do not become a schema renderer, visual form builder, or low-code platform.
strategicThemes: typed submit failures and schema input/output
agent-readable APIs, CLI, and migration workflows

autoExperimentWhen: The hypothesis stays within the documented product boundary.
At least two independent signals exist, or one signal includes a reproducible real-world scenario.
The experiment is isolated and does not change the public API or production package behavior.
Success and kill criteria are observable before the experiment starts.
humanAttentionWhen: The opportunity changes product positioning or validation ownership.
The next step adds or changes public API, exported types, compatibility promises, dependencies, CI, security, or release behavior.
Evidence supports several incompatible product choices.
The recommendation is promote with risk R2 or R3.
rejectWhen: The idea only copies a competitor feature without a vformjs lifecycle use case.
The idea requires vformjs to own input rendering or become a schema renderer.
The idea adds a second validation engine beside the host Form.
No observable user outcome or falsifiable experiment can be defined.
The only supporting evidence is an AI-generated hypothesis.
